message: ナショナル　ハムブルグ
Perhaps thanks to our previous success, requests for Angelic Agent have started trickling in.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Getting asked to do all sorts of things lets us experience so many different things, it's really exciting!\s05」
The leader is in a fantastic mood, too.

name: Synn
message: 「So, what kind of activity do we have today?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The chef at Prier said they'd like us to taste-test a new menu item.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh. Now that's a nice perk! So this is what being Student Council President is all about.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now, now. This is a proper mission, you know.」
I ended up getting admonished by someone whose own lips were curling into a grin.

name: Synn
message: 「So, is it just us at this tasting party?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Our Treasurer and Senpai headed over to help out the Umbrella Golf Club, and the Vice President went to the Wagashi Club.」

name: Synn
message: 「We're super popular, huh.」
Though I'd rather not think too much about what they're being made to do.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I haven't eaten lunch today, so my stomach is completely empty~」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha, you're raring to go, aren't you.」
As we waited with pounding hearts, dishes made of precious metal were brought out to us.

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa. They went out of their way to hide what's inside.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It must be a surprise!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What I wanna know is why they bothered getting plate cloches ready.」
The chef lifts off the dome-shaped lids.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa! It's hamburger steak!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, well, on its own it's just a plain old hamburger steak with nothing special about it.」

name: Synn
message: 「True. The hamburger steak lunch was already a staple on the menu, after all. Not that I've ever eaten it.」
Just as I was feeling skeptical, something with a wonderful aroma was brought out next.

name: Synn
message: 「Is this sauce?」

name: Paqy
message: 「A demi-glace sauce rich with the aroma of wine and mushrooms.」

name: Paqy
message: 「A rich, sweet sauce topped with whipped cream.」

name: Paqy
message: 「A soft cheese sauce with the aroma of basil」

name: Paqy
message: 「A harmony of cheese and tomato sauce」

name: Paqy
message: 「A refreshing soy-sauce-based sauce」

name: Paqy
message: 「A spicy tomato and chili sauce」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sluuurp~\s05」

name: Paqy
message: 「Basically, you could call it a multinational Hamburg steak」

name: Synn
message: 「Amazing... Lolotte, can we eat already?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's dig in!」
First up, the first sauce.

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's so yummy~\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「If there are too many mushrooms, the aroma gets overpowering, so it's better to keep them in moderation」
Trying out the next sauce.

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's so rich~\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't skimp here--you're better off using heavy cream instead of whipped cream」
Next is the yellow sauce.

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I feel like I'm gonna melt~\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「The downside is you get a little tired of it. If you're going that route, making it a Mornay sauce might be interesting」
Next is the two-tone red and yellow one.

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It tastes like ketchup~\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「Rather than store-bought tomato sauce, a sauce made from properly stewed tomatoes would look more dynamic too, I think」
A familiar classic sauce.

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Light and refreshing~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Grated daikon and shiso leaves would be nice here, though... I don't think that'd suit kids very well」
Finishing off with the bright red sauce.

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek, it's spicy!」

name: Paqy
message: 「The spices feel a bit strong, but this chili sauce is exquisite. Gonna try shrimp in chili sauce next?」
After savoring the full selection of sauces, I take a breather.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Isn't the next one ready yet?!」

name: Synn
message: 「You already ate so much, yet you can still keep going~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ufufu... I absolutely love hamburg steak, you know\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Oho~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I want to eat more~」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? You still have carrots and green beans left, though」
Only the hamburg steak had been neatly finished off, while the vegetable side dishes were pushed off to the corner.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Vegetables-especially carrots-aren't really my favorite, you see」

name: Synn
message: 「You hate them?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You could say that」

name: Synn
message: 「They're delicious, so it's a waste. I'd gladly eat them」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, please say 'aah'」

name: Synn
message: 「Ehh?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come on, open your mouth and go 'aah', please」

name: Synn
message: 「W-W-Wha, all of a sudden...\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because I think Mr. Vegetable would be happier if someone ate him gladly」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh. Even so, come on... if someone sees us, that'd be... e-e-embarrass--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you don't hurry up, I'm going to mash it right against your lips!」

name: Synn
message: 「Mghghgh」
H-H-How pushy can she get!

name: Lolotte
message: 「Here you go, Mr. Carrot♪」

name: Synn
message: 「A... aah」

name: Synn
message: 「Munch, munch」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is it delicious?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's... really... delicious」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, hmm, in what way?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're taste-testing it, so if you don't answer properly, it won't count as completing the mission」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't this supposed to be about the hamburg steak!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How does it taste?」

name: Synn
message: 「...It tasted like butter」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's wonderful! Now then, next up is Mr. Green Bean♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah, nom, nom」
It's kind of embarrassing, though it doesn't feel bad.
Still, I'm the only one getting flustered--Lolotte doesn't seem bothered by it at all.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ufufu. This is rather fun, isn't it」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha... It's almost like I'm back to being a baby」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A baby, you say~」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah...」
Well, it's not like I actually remember it clearly, though.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Baby, baby...」
She flips through her guidebook.

name: Lolotte
message: 「A tiny, roly-poly, cute human, is it? Hmm, hmm」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Lolotte... you don't know what a baby is?」
Did I touch on something I shouldn't have...?

name: Lolotte
message: 「I simply have no memory of anyone ever doing this sort of thing for me」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see. My family used to do it for me a lot, so...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Family... So families do things like this. Families really are mysterious~」
Maybe it's because she's a sheltered rich girl, but Lolotte has lived her life without knowing things I've always taken for granted.
On the flip side, I bet she knows tons of things I don't.
More importantly, aren't her mom and dad way too cold?

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, want to try saying 'ahh' too, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eh?! Really, is that okay?」
No sooner have I said it than I realize my mistake. Earlier was embarrassing enough, isn't this side just as embarrassing?!

name: Lolotte
message: 「Got it!」
She claps her hands together in front of her chest and faces me, fired up.
Now that it's come this far, I'm a man too. I just have to do it!

name: Synn
message: 「Here, say ahh!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? Huuuh~~ This is somehow really embarrassing!」

name: Synn
message: 「Right?! Still, I did it too, so...」

name: Synn
message: 「I pushed through it, so you hang in there too, Lolotte」
Resigning herself, Lolotte trembles nervously as she opens her little mouth.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah... a~~hh」
Seeing how desperately she's trying suddenly makes me smile. For some reason, she even has her eyes squeezed shut.

name: Synn
message: 「Here comes Mr. Carrot♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nom, nom... Eek!」

name: Synn
message: 「Next up, Mr. Green Bean♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nom, nom, it's bitter~」

name: Synn
message: 「Some nice stringy butterbur~♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There's no such thing!」
Lolotte's picky eating really is a handful.
